method.symmetric_perturbations: tangent to frozen candidate level, then projected back to C=0
method.fit: 9D full-vector inner +/-1/3 odd response, outer +/-1 held out; actual full10D normalized source
method.source_observation: perp gradient residual divided by normalized grad(C) norm; source is orthogonally tangent
method.common_frame: deterministic Householder initial baseline 9D frame; minimal Euclidean rotation to baseline normal at common time; each sample normal minimally mapped into that common frame
method.normal_tilt: atan2 vector in homogeneous transported-normal tangent plane; no arccos small-angle cancellations
method.initial_comparison: signed co-moving normalized level and signed projected tilt source
method.common_time: half of earliest support horizon: actual first exit when observed, otherwise right-censoring at end of measurement window
method.exit_censoring: NO_EXIT_OBSERVED is a right-censored observation; never report window end as an exit
method.caution: No certified material metric/invariant; the declared minimal-rotation gauge does not demonstrate physical torsion. v18.38 original scalar replay is mandatory. kappa0 unchanged.
